summary.short: Argentina's general personal data protection statute (sanctioned 4 October 2000, partially promulgated 30 October 2000). It governs personal data in public and private databases: principles, consent, cross-border transfer limits, data subject rights, registration, a control body, sanctions and the habeas data action.
summary.long: Argentina's general personal data protection statute. Chapter I defines personal, sensitive and health data, databases, processing, controllers and data subjects, covering public and private databases. Chapter II sets principles: data quality (Art. 4), consent with listed exceptions (Art. 5), information duties (Art. 6), limits on sensitive data (Art. 7), security and confidentiality (Arts. 9-10), assignment of data (Art. 11), and prohibition of transfers to countries without adequate protection, subject to exceptions (Art. 12). Chapter III grants information, access, rectification and deletion rights (Arts. 13-19) and bars decisions based solely on automated profiling (Art. 20). Chapter IV covers registration (Arts. 21, 24), public databases (Art. 22), processing services (Art. 25), credit reporting limits (Arts. 26, 47), direct marketing (Art. 27) and a survey exemption (Art. 28). Chapter V creates a control body (Art. 29) and allows codes of conduct (Art. 30). Chapter VI sets administrative sanctions of warning, suspension, fines of 1,000 to 100,000 pesos, and closure or cancellation (Art. 31), and adds penal code offences (Art. 32). Chapter VII regulates the habeas data action (Arts. 33-43). The statute does not mention artificial intelligence.

obligations.summary: Personal data collected for processing must be accurate, adequate, relevant and not excessive for the purpose; must not be collected by unfair means or used for incompatible purposes; must be updated, inaccurate or incomplete data corrected or deleted, and data destroyed when no longer necessary.

evidence.quote: deben ser ciertos, adecuados, pertinentes y no excesivos en relación al ámbito y finalidad para los que se hubieren obtenido

obligations.summary: Formation of data files is lawful only when properly registered; files must operate observing the law's principles and implementing regulations.

evidence.quote: La formación de archivos de datos será lícita cuando se encuentren debidamente inscriptos

obligations.summary: Data files may not have purposes contrary to law or public morals.

evidence.quote: Los archivos de datos no pueden tener finalidades contrarias a las leyes o a la moral pública.

obligations.summary: Processing of personal data is unlawful unless the data subject gave free, express and informed consent, in writing or equivalent; the consent must be expressly and prominently stated where given with other declarations, after prior notice under Art. 6. Consent is not required in the cases listed in Art. 5(2).

evidence.quote: El tratamiento de datos personales es ilícito cuando el titular no hubiere prestado su consentimiento libre, expreso e informado

obligations.summary: When collecting personal data, data subjects must be informed in advance, expressly and clearly, of the purpose and recipients, the existence and identity and address of the controller, whether replies are mandatory, the consequences of providing or refusing data, and their rights of access, rectification and deletion.

evidence.quote: Cuando se recaben datos personales se deberá informar previamente a sus titulares en forma expresa y clara

obligations.summary: No one may be obliged to provide sensitive data; sensitive data may be collected only for general-interest reasons authorised by law; files that directly or indirectly reveal sensitive data are prohibited, except that the Catholic Church, religious associations, and political and trade-union organisations may keep records of their members; criminal-record data may be processed only by competent public authorities.

evidence.quote: Queda prohibida la formación de archivos, bancos o registros que almacenen información que directa o indirectamente revele datos sensibles.

obligations.summary: Public or private health establishments and health-science professionals may collect and process health data of patients, respecting professional secrecy.

evidence.quote: pueden recolectar y tratar los datos personales relativos a la salud física o mental de los pacientes

obligations.summary: Controllers and users of data files must adopt technical and organisational measures necessary to guarantee the security and confidentiality of personal data, preventing alteration, loss, unauthorised access or processing, and detecting deviations.

evidence.quote: El responsable o usuario del archivo de datos debe adoptar las medidas técnicas y organizativas que resulten necesarias para garantizar la seguridad y confidencialidad de los datos personales

obligations.summary: Registering personal data in files that do not meet technical conditions of integrity and security is prohibited.

evidence.quote: Queda prohibido registrar datos personales en archivos, registros o bancos que no reúnan condiciones técnicas de integridad y seguridad.

obligations.summary: The controller and any persons involved in any phase of processing are bound by professional secrecy regarding the data, surviving the end of the relationship with the data file holder; release is possible only by judicial order and on grounds of public security, national defence or public health.

evidence.quote: están obligados al secreto profesional respecto de los mismos

obligations.summary: Personal data may be transferred (ceded) only for purposes directly related to the legitimate interest of transferor and transferee and with the data subject's prior consent, which must be informed as to purpose and identity of the transferee; consent is revocable. Exceptions are listed in Art. 11(3). The transferee is bound by the same obligations as the transferor, who is jointly liable.

evidence.quote: sólo pueden ser cedidos para el cumplimiento de los fines directamente relacionados con el interés legítimo del cedente y del cesionario

obligations.summary: Transfer of personal data of any kind to countries or international or supranational bodies that do not provide adequate protection levels is prohibited; exceptions are listed in Art. 12(2).
obligations.conditional_on: recipient does not provide adequate protection levels

evidence.quote: Es prohibida la transferencia de datos personales de cualquier tipo con países u organismos internacionales o supranacionales

obligations.summary: The register of data files kept by the control body must be publicly consultable and free of charge; any person may request information from the control body on the existence, purposes and controllers of personal data files.

evidence.quote: El registro que se lleve al efecto será de consulta pública y gratuita.

obligations.summary: Upon a data subject's identity being verified, the controller or user must provide the requested information on the subject's data within ten calendar days of formal demand; access is free at intervals of no less than six months unless legitimate interest is shown; for deceased persons, universal successors may exercise access.

evidence.quote: debe proporcionar la información solicitada dentro de los diez días corridos de haber sido intimado fehacientemente

obligations.summary: Information given to the data subject must be clear, free of codes, and explained in accessible language where necessary; it must cover the whole record of the data subject, and may be provided in writing or by electronic, telephonic or image means at the subject's option.

evidence.quote: La información debe ser suministrada en forma clara, exenta de codificaciones

obligations.summary: The controller or user must rectify, update or delete (or mark confidential) data within five business days of a claim or of noticing an error; notify rectification to transferees within the fifth business day; block the file or flag it as under review during verification; and retain data for the periods set by applicable rules or contract. Deletion is not required where it would harm third-party rights or a legal retention duty applies.

evidence.quote: debe proceder a la rectificación, supresión o actualización de los datos personales del afectado

obligations.summary: Controllers or users of public data files may, by reasoned decision, deny access, rectification or deletion on grounds of national defence, public order and security, or protection of third-party rights and interests; such refusals or decisions in judicial or administrative matters must be reasoned and notified to the data subject, and access must be given when the subject must exercise a right of defence.

evidence.quote: pueden, mediante decisión fundada, denegar el acceso, rectificación o la supresión

obligations.summary: Rectification, update or deletion of inaccurate or incomplete data in public or private registers must be carried out free of charge for the data subject.

evidence.quote: se efectuará sin cargo alguno para el interesado

obligations.summary: Judicial decisions and administrative acts that assess human conduct may not rest solely on the result of automated processing of personal data that defines the profile or personality of the person concerned; acts contrary to this are null.

evidence.quote: no podrán tener como único fundamento el resultado del tratamiento informatizado de datos personales que suministren una definición del perfil o personalidad del interesado

obligations.summary: Public data files, and private files intended to provide reports, must be registered in the register enabled by the control body, with the minimum information listed in Art. 21(2) (controller name and address, purpose, categories of data, collection method, recipients, security measures, retention period, and access procedures).

evidence.quote: debe inscribirse en el Registro que al efecto habilite el organismo de control.

obligations.summary: A data user may not hold personal data of a nature different from that declared in the register.

evidence.quote: Ningún usuario de datos podrá poseer datos personales de naturaleza distinta a los declarados en el registro.

obligations.summary: Rules creating, modifying or deleting public-body data files must be issued by general provision published in the official gazette, specifying the file's purpose, persons concerned, collection procedure, data categories, transfers, responsible bodies and claim offices; computerised records to be deleted must have their destination or destruction measures set out.

evidence.quote: deben hacerse por medio de disposición general publicada en el Boletín Oficial de la Nación o diario oficial.

obligations.summary: Armed forces, security forces, police and intelligence bodies processing personal data without consent are limited to data necessary for their legally assigned missions; such files must be specific and classified by reliability; police data must be cancelled when no longer needed for the inquiries that motivated it.

evidence.quote: queda limitado a aquellos supuestos y categoría de datos que resulten necesarios

obligations.summary: Private persons who keep files, registers or databases for non-exclusively personal use must register them under Art. 21.

evidence.quote: deberán registrarse conforme lo previsto en el artículo 21.

obligations.summary: Where personal data processing is provided as a service for third parties, the data may not be used for purposes other than those in the service contract, nor transferred to others, even for storage.

evidence.quote: no podrán aplicarse o utilizarse con un fin distinto al que figure en el contrato de servicios, ni cederlos a otras personas

obligations.summary: Once the contractual service is performed, processed personal data must be destroyed, unless the client expressly authorises storage where further engagements are reasonably expected, for up to two years under security conditions.

evidence.quote: Una vez cumplida la prestación contractual los datos personales tratados deberán ser destruidos

obligations.summary: Credit information services may process only personal financial data relating to solvency and credit, obtained from public sources or provided by the data subject or with consent; creditor-supplied data on compliance or default is also permitted.

evidence.quote: sólo pueden tratarse datos personales de carácter patrimonial relativos a la solvencia económica y al crédito

obligations.summary: On the data subject's request, the controller or user of a credit information file must communicate the information, assessments and appraisals communicated during the last six months and the name and address of any transferee of data obtained by transfer.

evidence.quote: A solicitud del titular de los datos, el responsable o usuario del banco de datos, le comunicará las informaciones

obligations.summary: Credit information data may be archived, recorded or transferred only if significant for assessing financial solvency over the last five years; this period is reduced to two years where the debtor extinguishes the obligation, and the extinction must be recorded.

evidence.quote: Sólo se podrán archivar, registrar o ceder los datos personales que sean significativos para evaluar la solvencia económico-financiera de los afectados durante los últimos cinco años.

obligations.summary: For direct marketing and similar files, the data subject may exercise access free of charge, and may at any time request removal or blocking of their name from such databases, which the controller must honour.

evidence.quote: el titular de los datos podrá ejercer el derecho de acceso sin cargo alguno

obligations.summary: Where anonymity cannot be maintained during data collection, a dissociation technique must be used so that no person can be identified.
obligations.conditional_on: where anonymity cannot be maintained during collection

obligations.summary: The control body must perform all actions necessary to meet the law's objectives, including advising persons on their rights, monitoring compliance with data integrity and security rules, carrying out a census of files and keeping the permanent register, controlling registration requirements for credit files, and bringing criminal complaints for violations.

evidence.quote: El órgano de control deberá realizar todas las acciones necesarias para el cumplimiento de los objetivos y demás disposiciones de la presente ley.

obligations.summary: The control body must issue the rules and regulations to be observed in the activities covered by the law.

obligations.summary: Credit information databases must delete and stop recording future entries on obligations and ratings of persons whose commercial debts were in default, or whose financial debts were classified in categories 2 to 5 under Central Bank rules, between 1 January 2000 and 10 December 2003, where the debts were cancelled or regularised at entry into force or within 180 days after; a payment plan or homologated arrangement counts as regularisation.
obligations.applies_from: at entry into force of the law, or within 180 days after
obligations.conditional_on: debts cancelled or regularised; debts in default or classified 2 to 5 between 1 January 2000 and 10 December 2003

evidence.quote: deberán eliminar y omitir el asiento en el futuro de todo dato referido a obligaciones y calificaciones asociadas

obligations.summary: The Central Bank must establish the mechanisms financial institutions must follow to report data to it for the purposes of Art. 47, and must take measures so that those consulting its debtor central are informed of the effects of Art. 47.

evidence.quote: El Banco Central de la República Argentina establecerá los mecanismos que deben cumplir las Entidades Financieras

obligations.summary: Financial institutions must follow the Central Bank's mechanisms to report the data needed to identify the cases covered by Art. 47.

evidence.quote: para informar a dicho organismo los datos necesarios para la determinación de los casos encuadrados

obligations.summary: A creditor that has transferred data on non-performance of an original obligation must notify every file, register or database to which it ceded the data of the obligation's cancellation or regularisation.

evidence.quote: el acreedor debe comunicar a todo archivo, registro o banco de datos al que hubiera cedido datos referentes al incumplimiento de la obligación original, su cancelación o regularización.
